title.narrative: Polynesian Health Corridors Programme - Phase II

description.narrative: A second five-year phase of the Polynesian Health Corridors programme, managed by the Public Health Agency, New Zealand Ministry of Health. It will assist six Polynesian countries (Cook Islands, Niue, Samoa, Tokelau, Tonga and Tuvalu) to address Health Security, Noncommunicable Diseases (Mental Health, Cancer Control), and Access to Essential Medicines, by building and deepening connections between New Zealand health system partners and Polynesian countries' health systems.
